title: Codeium Rebrand to Windsurf - April 2025
description: Codeium has fully rebranded to Windsurf in April 2025 with a refreshed brand identity, new pricing model with upgraded free tier, expanded model availability, and the transition of 'Codeium Extensions' to 'Windsurf Plugins'. This was described as a 'milestone month' marking the complete brand transition with significant improvements to pricing, features, and user experience.

community_feedback.quote: I wanted to share my disappointing experience with Windsurf regarding their early adopter pricing promises
Introducing our new Windsurf pricing plans with simplified tiers across Free, Pro, and Teams, plus a new Max plan

title: Aider v0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Released v0.86.0 with support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4 via xAI and OpenRouter providers, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite preview model. Added model announcement display, improved commit message output readability, and OpenRouter OAuth authentication flow. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

title: Aider v0.85.0 - Gemini 2.5 and Thinking Tokens
description: Released v0.85.0 with support for new Gemini 2.5 Pro, Flash, and Pro Preview models with thinking tokens support. Added Responses API models (o1-pro, o3-pro), OpenAI o3-pro support, enhanced thinking tokens configuration, --add-gitignore-files flag, and co-authored-by attribution enabled by default. Added MATLAB and Clojure repository map support.

title: GPT-5 Codex Support - November 2025
description: Continue added full GPT-5 Codex and advanced model integration with comprehensive Responses API support for streaming and non-streaming capabilities. Implemented Instant Edit for find/replace tools with immediate diff application, and integrated xAI's Grok Code Fast 1 as a recommended agent model with full tool support.

community_feedback.quote: GPT-5.2-Codex is optimized for autonomous coding tasks with improved long-context understanding and extended runtime (7+ hours on complex tasks)
I am using 5.4, but it feels like I am talking to GPT-3.5. It is making basic programming mistakes and not following prompts correctly

title: New Agent Upgrade and Enterprise API v3 - 2025
description: All enterprise customers upgraded to newest Devin version with latest architectural and model improvements. Legacy 'Agent (old)' option removed. New Enterprise API v3 endpoints for tracking usage metrics, active users, sessions, searches, and PRs with time-series data. Added custom slash commands management, Microsoft Teams integration, Data Analyst Devin (Dana), and enhanced consumption analytics with 12-month historical data.
